column1: # <owner/repo><TAB><glob>, one per line: the SEED of the jobs worker's lead_protected_paths
# rows (BH-4148). Not the source of truth: the DB rows are. bin/lead-protected-paths-seed.sh
# PUTs these; until a glob has a row in the DB (live or removed), bin/lib/lead-authority.sh
# still treats it as protected, so an unseeded or reset table never ungoverns them.
# Add or remove a protected path on SETTINGS -> PROTECTED PATHS, not here.
# example-org/project-3 — the member-facing paths (BH-9625, project-3, 2026-11-12). The repo's
# lead_authority_mode.example-org.project-3 row is `client`: a PR that touches one of these
# merges only on a --source human MERGE that links the decision maker's written approval.
